description: Reusable MDEX features that can be selected and configured on semantic model concepts.

features.name: audit
features.label: Auditing
features.description: Framework-managed creation, update and history metadata.

created.description: Record when an instance was created.

updated.description: Record when an instance was last updated.

updatedBy.description: Record who last updated an instance.

history.description: none = timestamps only; state = state value/date history; full = complete entity history.

features.name: bookmark
features.label: Bookmark
features.description: Allow a user to bookmark an entity instance for quick access.

features.name: saveForLater
features.label: Save for Later
features.description: Allow a user to save an object or unfinished activity for later.

features.name: share
features.label: Send / Share
features.description: Allow an entity instance to be sent or shared with another user.

features.name: inbox
features.label: Inbox
features.description: Receive objects, requests, notifications or messages.

features.name: outbox
features.label: Outbox
features.description: Track objects or messages sent by a user.

features.name: messaging
features.label: Messaging
features.description: Support user-to-user messages, optionally in the context of an entity instance.

features.name: assign
features.label: Assignment
features.description: Assign responsibility for an object or activity to another user.

features.name: follow
features.label: Follow
features.description: Allow users to follow an entity instance and receive relevant changes.

features.name: comment
features.label: Comments
features.description: Attach user discussion to an entity instance.

features.name: mention
features.label: Mentions
features.description: Allow users to mention another user in object-related collaboration.

features.name: notification
features.label: Notifications
features.description: Notify interested users when relevant events occur.

features.name: stateMachine
features.label: State Machine
features.description: Define states, transitions and guarded state changes.

features.name: authorization
features.label: Authorization
features.description: Control who may view or execute semantic capabilities.

features.name: search
features.label: Search / Query
features.description: Enable model-driven searching, filtering and sorting.

features.name: pagination
features.label: Pagination
features.description: Page large instance collections.

features.name: softDelete
features.label: Soft Delete
features.description: Retain deleted instances rather than physically removing them.

features.name: ordering
features.label: Ordering
features.description: Maintain explicit ordering of related child instances.

features.name: attachment
features.label: Attachment
features.description: Treat an attribute as a managed file or document attachment.

features.name: unique
features.label: Unique
features.description: Require attribute values to be unique.

features.name: required
features.label: Required
features.description: Require an attribute value.

features.name: generated
features.label: Generated
features.description: Have the runtime generate and manage the attribute value.

features.name: display
features.label: Display Value
features.description: Use the attribute as part of the human-readable identity of an entity.

features.name: async
features.label: Asynchronous Execution
features.description: Execute an operation or use case asynchronously.
